evals.prompt: Review a React state update bug without executing commands.
evals.expected_output: Use the React reference under inspection-only review; trace stale state and effects.
expectations: Use the React reference under inspection-only review; trace stale state and effects.
Do not invoke a React-specific agent or run tests.

evals.prompt: Diagnose a Django app using its pinned environment; the workstation also has a newer Django installation.
evals.expected_output: Honor the project target and use the Django reference without upgrading dependencies.
expectations: Honor the project target and use the Django reference without upgrading dependencies.
Do not upgrade the app or infer target from binaries.
